title: nice and simple app
body: But thats also the problem, it's too expencive for a nice and simple app. $60 one time purchase or $5 per month is simply ridiculous.
author: ggurbb

title: Great application!
body:
Great application, use it daily to track my habits.

One thing I would like to see is the ability to make a habit for longer periods of time. Right now, you can only make weekly habits, but I would like to be able to make a 2-weeks habit (for instance).

Also, the application crashes sometimes when I open it.

All in all, it’s the perfect app for tracking habits, with a clean minimalistic design!

body: Not flexible enough; it’s similar to a task list and does, for example, not offer the option to add amounts to your habits (e.g. drink at least 3 cups of tea per day, or eat at most 3 eggs per week). Instead, it’s just a list of habits that you can check off, not much more.

author: gerard-83

title: I like it! I believe in the power of This app!
body:
I used the app for 2 days now. I found it by accident and I really liked This idea. By installing This app you automatically set the first intention to create new habits. You have to conciously think about which habit/activity to want to create. Ticking them off feels good and keeping the list short is the best way to begin! I use: meditate, core training, read. Today I added: write. 

I think it will be very inspirational to be able to see more habit suggestions in the app to choose from. This will inspire and motivate to consider new/more goals.
author: Nathalie de Vries

title: Love this app
body: It really helps to develop new habits, on time notifications and great graphics to show how you did. It’s very convenient. Also one payment for premium is a big plus for us, really don’t like subscriptions. Very satisfied user!
author: Mr_Shickadance

title: Nicest and easiest interface for a habit app
body:
I don’t have to convince anyone about the power of creating habits.

I’ve tried many different ones that focus on building streaks trying to look fancy but are complicated to use, or simply buggy and unusable.

Habitify is the one and only habit app that feels rock solid stability, looks clean, and focuses on its single most important function: get you to check in every single day to change your life.

author: Denouder

title: Not too well thought through
body: Habitify is a nice app to change behaviours but it could be improved and there is one big mistake in it. For instance, I have the "no screen after 22:00" habit that I want to pursue. Habitify sends me a message after 22:00 to ask me if I managed to do this today. Pretty evil. The messages, are placed shortly after one another 19:00 and 19:20 (I guess by default, I didn't see it in the settings) which is too close to make a difference. At least for me. It could do with a few more motivational messages as well in the free version. I keep getting the same one day in day out which wears out. But if you want to kick a habit I do recommend giving it a try as scientifically it should work.

title: Suggestion

author: Piter_S

title: Super app!
body:
Een prachtige manier om nieuwe gewoontes aan te leren; gewoontes die je altijd had willen hebben, maar nooit de motivatie voor op kon brengen. Habitify maakt het bovendien pijnlijk duidelijk op de progress tab als je gewenste nieuwe gewoontes toch niet zomaar aanslaan, heel verhelderend. Normaal gesproken was ik die gewoontes anders gewoon weer vergeten...
Inspirerende motivatie quotes helpen je de 40 dagen overbruggen die je over het algemeen nodig hebt om je nieuwe gewoonte werkelijk te laten beklijven --- aanrader!!
